add_roles.reason: Core architecture-domain technician role bridging architect and construction; ESCO-recognised and missing from list.
Standard built-environment/architecture-adjacent surveying profession absent despite many other surveyor roles present.
Key architecture/construction design discipline (MEP) globally recognised, not represented.

reviews.notes: Domain labelled 'Architecture' but dominated by surveying, civil-engineering technicians, energy assessors, rail/road/sewerage infrastructure and fire-safety roles that belong in Civil Engineering, Energy, or Safety domains. Core architecture roles (architect, interior architect, landscape architect/designer) are underrepresented while ~half the list is off-theme fan-out (esp. duplicated energy* and fire* clusters). Aggregate SOC-title rows (Architects and Surveyors, Cartographers and Photogrammetrists, etc.) are census categories not job roles but kept as they are on-theme. Recommend either rename to reflect built-environment scope or move infrastructure/energy/fire clusters out.

add_roles.reason: Frontline blasting operative distinct from explosives engineer; standard mining occupation absent from list.
Global core mining production role; only underground/surface generic miners present.

reviews.notes: Domain is largely coherent (mining, quarrying, oil & gas drilling, metallurgy, applied geology). Off-theme: oceanographer, palaeontologist, seismologist and desalination technician are earth/marine-science or water-treatment roles not extractive occupations. Water-science roles (hydrologist, hydrogeologist) are borderline fan-out — retained as they support mine dewatering/hydrogeology but noted. Numerous ALL-CAPS rows are US SOC census aggregate categories (e.g. 'Roof Bolters, Mining', 'Extraction Workers, All Other') rather than discrete job titles; acceptable as ISCO 8111/8113 crosswalk anchors. Rename suggested to reflect combined extraction+geoscience scope.

add_roles.reason: Core medical specialty; present only as US SOC row 'Physicians, Pathologists' but no ESCO-style discrete role.
Generic specialist physician role; list has many named sub-specialties but the 'doctors' entry is mis-mapped to ISCO 3256 assistant.

reviews.notes: Domain is coherent for medicine/physicians but has two clear cross-domain contaminants: 'Architectural and Engineering Managers' and 'Biofuels/Biodiesel Technology and Product Development Managers' — both US SOC rows that share ISCO 1342 (health-services manager) crosswalk and were wrongly pulled in; remove. 'Health and Education Services Managers' is an over-broad aggregate spanning education too. The 'doctors' entry is mis-mapped to ISCO 3256 (medical assistant) rather than a physician code. Heavy over-fanout: ~25 individual physician sub-specialties are enumerated as separate US SOC rows (Cardiologists, Dermatologists, etc.) where a single 'specialised doctor' (already present, ISCO 2212) covers them — collapse recommended. 'Midwives' overlaps the Nursing domain. Kept aggregate lab-technologist rows as on-theme.

add_roles.reason: Community/home nursing is a core global nursing role only implied via aka on 'nurse responsible for general care'; warrants discrete entry.
Major nursing specialty worldwide; present only as an aka, not a standalone role.

reviews.notes: Core nursing roles (specialist nurse, advanced nurse practitioner, midwife, nurse assistant) and the SOC nurse rows are correct and on-theme. However the domain is heavily padded with two off-theme clusters: (1) an ISCO 3258 diagnostic-imaging/technologist group (sonographers, radiologic, nuclear-medicine, dosimetrists, neurodiagnostic, ophthalmic, cardiovascular techs) that belongs in a Medical Imaging/Diagnostics domain, and (2) non-nursing support roles — veterinary assistants, pharmacy aides, dental assistants, chiropractic assistant, assistant clinical psychologist. Records/coding/PACS roles (medical records clerk, clinical coder, PACS admin) are health-information not nursing but borderline; left in. Care-aide 5321 cluster is over-fanned. Rename or split imaging cluster out; add discrete district/mental-health nurse roles.

add_roles.reason: Pharmaceutical-technicians occupation is thin (only pharmacy technician/assistant); dispensing technician is a distinct global support role.
Industrial pharmacy has no shop-floor technician representation despite manufacturing pharmacists being listed.

reviews.notes: Domain is on-theme for pharmacy but has data-quality issues. Contaminants: 'optical technician' and 'optician' (ISCO 3254 ophthalmic dispensing, not pharmacy) and three SOC rows mis-bucketed via 3254/3213 crosswalk — 'Paramedics', 'Dietetic Technicians', 'Psychiatric Technicians' — all belong to other allied-health domains; remove. Duplication/ISCO inconsistency: 'hospital pharmacist' and 'industrial pharmacist' each appear twice with conflicting codes (2262 vs 2215), and 'clinical pharmacologist' is coded 2211 (physician). The correct pharmacist ISCO is 2262 in ISCO-08; the 2215 entries appear to be a second data source — dedupe and standardise to 2262. Verdict issues mainly for contaminant removal and duplicate/code cleanup rather than fan-out.
